name: (02) Mortis (Path of the Four Humours) — 1 Basic — Kiss of the Dark Mother

system.description:
Drawing up your own black bile and mingling it with your blood, you channel the debased fluid to your lips as a venomous substitute for saliva, making your bite a truly deadly thing.

Once you have channeled the tainted blood to your mouth, every bite for the rest of the scene inflicts an additional health level of aggravated damage; this applies whenever you successfully land a biting attack. No challenge is required to activate it, and Mortis retests with Occult. It takes one full turn to clean the substance from your mouth and end the effect.
